diagrams.alt: On one RHEL 9.8 VM, the root renewal job replaced active.pem with a mode 0600 file. The autohttps service could not read it: 78 of 80 requests failed. Changing the script to write mode 0640 allowed all 100 requests in the next test to succeed.
diagrams.caption: The renewal script replaced a readable certificate file with a root-only file owned by root:autohttps. Mode 0600 removed group read access. The agent changed the script to write 0640 files. All 100 requests in the next test succeeded.
